open_general.applicable_condition: Students admitted under Open / General merit without any government subsidy.

obc.applicable_condition: CAP-admitted OBC students with Caste, Validity and valid Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate with parental income <= Rs. 8,00,000.

vj_nt_sbc.applicable_condition: CAP-admitted VJ/NT/SBC category students with valid Caste, Validity and NCL certificates.

tfws.applicable_condition: Students allotted specifically through State CET Cell TFWS quota seats.

sc_st.applicable_condition: CAP-admitted SC/ST students with Caste and Validity certificates; tuition & development fees reimbursed by Govt.

girls_scheme_ebc.applicable_condition: Female students admitted through CAP with family income <= Rs. 8 Lakhs under Govt Free Education for Girls policy.

institutional_quota.applicable_condition: Admissions through 20% Institute Level / Management quota; government scholarships not applicable.

payment_frequency: Annual payment at the time of admission; semester installments allowed upon written approval from Accounts Office
payment_modes: Online Net Banking / UPI via DKTE ERP Parent Portal
Debit Card / Credit Card swipe at College Accounts Counter
Demand Draft in favor of 'Director, DKTE Society's TEI, Ichalkaranji' payable at Ichalkaranji
